Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office files incoming paperwork as a dated case file, assigns a unique identifier, logs field values in fixed columns, and routes each document through sequential review sign-offs before closure.

2) What occurred: The actor prepared a dated inspection report with a corrected status field while the original status field remained unverified. The actor transmitted a payment instrument to a named account while the source account field was unverified. The actor replaced the original report with a falsified document while the original document's checksum field remained unverified. The actor altered the filing date in the case index while the prior filing date field was unverified. The actor added a reviewer sign-off to the cover sheet while the reviewer identity field was unverified. The actor archived the superseded document in an unindexed location while the archive location field was unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: The actor used a dated inspection report, a corrected status field, a payment instrument, a named account, a falsified document, a checksum field, a case index, a filing date field, a cover sheet, a reviewer sign-off, a reviewer identity field, and an archive location field.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Indicators included a mismatch between the corrected status field and the original status field, a payment instrument without a matching source account field, a falsified document with a different checksum value, a filing date earlier than the prior filing date, a sign-off with an unverified reviewer identity, and a document in an unindexed archive location. Artifacts included the original report, the falsified document, the payment instrument, the case index entry, the cover sheet, and the archive location record.
